usage.current_hour: Use current_hour routes with step=3600 on UTC hour boundaries for 24-hour charts. Directory requests require all 3 previous-hop strata for each of all 10 classes; never divide a partial stratum count by 3.
usage.sampled_hour: Use step=21600 on 6-hour UTC boundaries for historical hourly reference. Expression uses a 1h window.
usage.daily: Use step=86400 on UTC midnight boundaries (00:00:00 UTC). Expression uses a non-overlapping 1d window.
usage.current24: Same direct 1d estimator as daily history; query [end-3600,end] with step=3600 on UTC hour boundaries and retain the final result. Never replace it with an average of hourly rate estimates.
usage.metadata: Aggregate counts only; query [end-3600,end] step=3600 on UTC hour boundaries and retain final result.
usage.attestations: The four attested/proof IDs are gateway-computed descriptors, not source Prometheus metrics. They revalidate private process-epoch attestations excluding relays already claimed by verified_binary or stock_config and expose aggregate public version labels only across completed UTC hour boundaries.
usage.verified_binary: Cohort binary routes require a valid fingerprint-verified recorded state hash matched to fresh CPU identity by member, PID, start ticks and boot ID. CPU source age must be in [0,180) seconds. The collector additionally accepts only approved public binary hashes.
usage.stock_config: Live non-custom Tor version counts from onionforge_tor_process_config_info excluding relays present in tor41339_build_info or emitting custom HSDir metrics, pairwise disjoint with verified_binary and attested.
usage.dos_config: Aggregate DoS effective threshold/source counts from onionforge_tor_process_effective_config_info (joined to active tor_relays) and aggregate DoSBeginDir*/HSDirOneRequestPerCircuit policy/source counts from tor41339_upstream_policy_value (joined to active tor_relays); collector applies <8 suppression and dir-spec coarsening.

postprocessing: Collector still applies the 90% population coverage test and rolling 31-day/32-day denominator, null masking, per-relay normalization and midrank reference calculation. Fetch the required prior windows in bounded requests; the gateway only returns reviewed raw aggregates.
